name: tourist-map-system
description: Tourist Map Platform monorepo — Stage 1 Web Platform (Phase 1A: Foundation).

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter shared-types run build && pnpm --filter validation run build && pnpm --filter map-theme-adapter run build
scripts.test:rules: cd firebase && firebase --project touristmap-local emulators:exec --only firestore "pnpm --filter firebase-functions run test:rules"
scripts.test:provisioning: cd firebase && firebase --project touristmap-local emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "pnpm --filter firebase-functions run test:provisioning"
scripts.test:e2e: cd firebase && firebase --project touristmap-local emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "pnpm --filter admin-web run test:e2e"
